title: logit-thermo: code, registration documents, results and per-step data for "A first-order prediction from unpenalized samples of how a repetition penalty changes switching into and out of repetitive text"
description: Code, dated registration documents, predictions recorded before each test, summary results, and per-step quantities (candidate choices, candidate probabilities, repeat marks and counts; no tokens or text) for the manuscript "A first-order prediction from unpenalized samples of how a repetition penalty changes switching into and out of repetitive text". Article texts and generated tokens are not included.
